# opnsense_auth_user_api_key (Resource)

API keys authenticate machine-to-machine access to OPNsense as a local user. The secret is returned by OPNsense only when the key is created, so Terraform stores it as sensitive state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Name of the local OPNsense user that owns this API key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String, Sensitive) Encoded API-key identifier used by OPNsense to revoke the key.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) API key identifier returned by OPNsense.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) API key secret, returned only once when the key is created.
